time_protocol: For every country, the 2013 gross-capital-formation growth value is the signal and the 2014 GDP-per-capita growth value is the later outcome.
transformation: Selected the seven countries with both named observations and serialized the published decimal values without imputation or rescaling.
scope_limit: Macroeconomic cross-sectional workflow illustration only; not equity-alpha or causal evidence. A separate pure-Python oracle checks only serialization, time order and arithmetic.
